name: Clippers Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: tall orange hair clippers with a worried face, a silver comb blade and a black cord
entry: It buzzes through fur and hair alike. Fluffy Pokémon flee when they hear it coming.
how: Use a Clipper Blade on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Mirror Shot in this form.
